matched_packages.name: LL728/moon_encoding
matched_packages.summary:
LL728/moon_encoding is a MoonBit implementation of the WHATWG Encoding Standard, providing full coverage for 40 encodings and 228 labels. It offers both one-shot APIs like decode and encode, and a streaming decoder API for chunked byte processing.

name: moonbitlang/pdflite
description: Byte-oriented PDF reading, writing, and manipulation toolkit for MoonBit.

matched_packages.name: moonbitlang/pdflite/text/cmapdata
matched_packages.summary:
This module provides various predefined CMap lookup tables for handling text encoding in PDF files, including tables for B5PC, Big5, CNS1, GB1, GBK, GBKP, GBPC, HKDLA, HKDLB, HKGCCS, HKM314, HKM471, HKSCs, Japan1, KSC, KSCPC, and UHC. These tables are unpacked at load time.

Keywords: moonbitlang/pdflite/text/cmapdata, CMap lookup table, pdf_text_b5pc_charcode_table, pdf_text_big5_charcode_table, pdf_text_japan1_codepoint_ranges
